sentence: A single-choice vote on where to eat, where each person gets one vote, can change it, and anyone can add a new place (up to six).
use_when: A group needs to pick a place to eat together
Everyone should get one vote on a short list of options
People may want to suggest extra places while voting
A quick decision is needed with a visible leader or tie
dont_use_when: People need to pick several options at once, such as a multi-choice poll
A time or date must be chosen with availability for each person
Costs need to be split or tracked after the meal
